content.title: Engage with the City
content.summary: The City of Arvada offers various platforms for community engagement, allowing residents to report issues, provide feedback, and connect with neighbors. Key resources include the Ask Arvada service request platform, the Speak Up Arvada feedback tool, and opportunities to participate in City Council meetings. Residents are also encouraged to volunteer in various capacities to support local initiatives and enhance community involvement.
content.body:
## Welcome

Welcome to the City of Arvada's portal for community engagement. It is our goal to make sure every resident feels welcome to engage with us through the platforms best suited to their lifestyles. There are many ways to engage with the City. We want to help you navigate through those many opportunities and select the ones that work best for you.

## Stay Informed

You can connect with us on any of our many social media platforms, find out about breaking news through our news feed or learn what's happening in Arvada via the ArvadaNews and the Arvada Report. Visit [Subscribe, Follow, Stay Informed](/1349/Subscribe-follow-stay-informed).

1. [Report a Problem](#tab1fc5d622-fa83-46f7-b7ef-678d656ecdaf_0)

![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=2358)Ask Arvada is the City's online, 24/7 digital service request platform. Residents can report  problems or request a service from the comfort of their home during hours that are convenient for them. City staff will respond to requests within three days, and residents can track the status of their requests.

- Visit the [Ask Arvada page](/898) for information on how to report an issue or request service.
- Call Us on the Phone: To reach City Hall during normal business hours (8 am to 5 pm. Monday through Friday), dial 720-898-7000.
- Visit Us in Person: Arvada City Hall is located at 8101 Ralston Road, Arvada, CO 80002

1. [Share Your Feedback](#tab1fc5d622-fa83-46f7-b7ef-678d656ecdaf_1)

![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=238)Speak Up Arvada is the City's online, 24/7 digital engagement platform where you can give us feedback and share ideas about issues that you care about at times that are convenient for you. On the site, you'll find tools for engaging with the City and resources for staying informed. Within a project, you can take a survey or a poll, share a comment, idea, or a question, or drop a pin on a map All feedback is considered by the City team when making recommendations on a project and shared with the City's leadership and City Council.

- Register on [Speak Up Arvada](https://speakup.arvadaco.gov) to share your perspective on issues that matter to you.
- [Email Speak Up Arvada](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#780b081d19130d08190a0e191c1938190a0e191c1956170a1f) if you have questions.

1. [Connect with Your Neighbors](#tab1fc5d622-fa83-46f7-b7ef-678d656ecdaf_2)

![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=237)Neighbors knowing neighbors is at the core of every strong community. The City offers resources and training opportunities to residents who would like to strengthen their community through impactful projects and activities. Visit [Neighbors Connected](/482/Neighbors-Connected).

- **Interested in learning more**? Visit[Neighbors Connected](/482/Neighbors-Connected) to learn more about the programs and opportunities available to you!
- **Questions**? [Email Neighborhood Arvada](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#d1bfb4b8b6b9b3bea3b9bebeb5a291b0a3a7b0b5b0ffbea3b6).

1. [Engage with Your City council](#tab1fc5d622-fa83-46f7-b7ef-678d656ecdaf_3)

At City Council meetings (held on Tuesdays), councilmembers hear public comment about and discuss and vote on a variety of resolutions and ordinances that set the strategic and policy direction of the City and affect the lives of Arvada residents. City councilmembers want your input. You can attend a public hearing to share your views, or participate in the Open Comment portion of Council meetings on items not otherwise on the agenda. For more information, visit the [**City Council webpage**](/157).

1. [Volunteer for the City](#tab1fc5d622-fa83-46f7-b7ef-678d656ecdaf_4)

The City relies on volunteers to help make the organization successful. Volunteers serve as ambassadors at the Arvada Reservoir, in our parks and at Majestic View Nature Center. They serve on boards and commissions. Volunteers help keep our streets and trails clean. And our public safety volunteers support the Police Department by helping with administrative functions and other day-to-day operations. Volunteering for the City is a great way to participate in local government and give back to your community. For more information on volunteer opportunities, visit [Volunteer Opportunities page](https://co-arvada.civicplus.com/695/Volunteer-Opportunities).

1. [Attend a Meeting or Open House](#tab1fc5d622-fa83-46f7-b7ef-678d656ecdaf_5)

The City team regularly hosts community meetings and open houses across the city to inform the community about various projects and often to solicit resident input to help improve the project. The City regularly advertises public meetings [on social media](https://www.arvadaco.gov/897/Find-Us-Online), in the [Arvada Report](https://www.arvadaco.gov/604/Arvada-Report) and the [ArvadaNews](https://www.arvadaco.gov/608/Sign-Up-for-City-Newsletter).

1. [Serve on a City Board or Commission](#tab1fc5d622-fa83-46f7-b7ef-678d656ecdaf_6)

The Arvada City Council relies on community volunteers to study special community issues, obtain public comment on key projects, and offer recommendations on matters that affect the quality of life in Arvada. These groups are part of the community's voice, influencing public policy and decisions that affect the entire city. The City team recruits for boards and commissions members in December of each year. For more about boards and commissions, visit [Boards, Commissions, and Committees page](https://co-arvada.civicplus.com/248/Boards-Commissions-and-Committees).
